1692.name: Breakneck Blitz
1692.description: Pokémon knocked out by this Attack's damage are temporarily excluded from the duel, returning to the bench 7 turns later.

1693.name: Bloom Doom
1693.description: Removes all special conditions from your Pokémon.

1694.name: Inferno Overdrive
1694.description: The battle opponent and the Pokémon in a straight line directly behind it become burned.

1695.name: Hydro Vortex
1695.description: The battle opponent and opposing Pokémon within 2 steps of it become confused.

1697.name: Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike
1697.description: If the battle opponent is knocked out, then after the battle, this Pokémon moves to a point 2 steps away.

1698.name: Searing Sunraze Smash
1698.description: The battle opponent temporarily moves to the Ultra Space, returning to the bench after 7 turns. The battle opponent is not knocked out. Pokémon in a straight line directly behind the battle opponent gain Wait 3.

1699.name: Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom
1699.description: The battle opponent temporarily moves to the Ultra Space, returning to the bench after 7 turns. Opposing Pokémon adjacent to the battle opponent gain Wait 3.

1707.name: Corkscrew Crash
1707.description: If the battle opponent is knocked out, then after the battle, this Pokémon moves to a point 2 steps away.

1708.name: Extreme Evoboost
1708.description: Your Eevee and their Evolutions deal +50 damage while they are on the field.

1709.name: Sinister Arrow Raid
1709.description: Opposing Pokémon within 2 steps of the battle opponent spin. Those that spin Purple Attacks are knocked out.

1710.name: Malicious Moonsault
1710.description: Any Pokémon adjacent to the battle opponent other than this Pokémon spin. Those that spin White Attacks gain Wait 3.

1711.name: Oceanic Operetta
1711.description: All opposing Pokémon on the field spin. Those that spin Blue Attacks are knocked out.

1712.name: Gigavolt Havoc
1712.description: The battle opponent and a succession of Pokémon adjacent to the battle opponent (other than this Pokémon) become paralyzed.

1713.name: Supersonic Skystrike
1713.description: Any Pokémon adjacent to the battle opponent other than this Pokémon spin. Those that spin White Attacks move to the bench. This Pokémon gains Wait 3.

1714.name: All-Out Pummeling
1714.description: Attaches a Cracked marker to opposing Pokémon in a straight line directly behind the battle opponent.

1716.name: Savage Spin-Out
1716.description: Attaches an MP −2 marker to opposing Pokémon within 2 steps.

1717.name: Continental Crush
1717.description: The battle opponent and opposing Pokémon adjacent to the battle opponent gain Wait 9.

1718.name: Black Hole Eclipse
1718.description: Reduces the opponent's Z-Move gauge by two thirds of its max value.

1719.name: Subzero Slammer
1719.description: An opposing Pokémon within 2 steps becomes frozen.

1720.name: Acid Downpour
1720.description: All opposing Pokémon on the field spin. Those that spin White Attacks become poisoned.

1721.name: Never-Ending Nightmare
1721.description: All opposing Pokémon on the field spin. Those that spin White Attacks get an MP −1 marker.

1722.name: Shattered Psyche
1722.description: If this Pokémon is on the field, this Pokémon moves to a point 3 steps away after battle.

1723.name: Devastating Drake
1723.description: A Pokémon on the field spins. If it spins a Miss or a White Attack of 120 damage or more, it is knocked out.

1724.name: Twinkle Tackle
1724.description: Moves the battle opponent to the bench.

1733.name: Light That Burns the Sky
1733.description: An opposing Pokémon within X+1 steps spins, where X is the number of Pokémon in the Ultra Space. If it spins a Purple Attack, that Pokémon is excluded from the duel.

1758.name: Guardian of Alola
1758.description: Pokémon knocked out by this Attack are temporarily excluded from the duel, moving to their P.C. 5 turns later.

1770.name: Let's Snuggle Forever
1770.description: Moves the battle opponent to its P.C. The battle opponent is not knocked out.

1771.name: Genesis Supernova
1771.description: All opposing Pokémon on the field spin. Those that spin a Purple Attack are knocked out. This Pokémon is excluded from the duel.

1772.name: Pulverizing Pancake
1772.description: Knocks the battle opponent and all Pokémon in a straight line directly behind it as far back as possible (the battle opponent is not knocked out). Those Pokémon gain Wait.
